sections.heading: Conclusions
lines: The challenge was to beat a large number of aggressive competitors with a limited daily budget.

We committed a huge number of hours for the initial development of keywords and semantics, taking into account the large repertoire of insects. In particular, it was important to create a proper account structure in particular, and to categorize campaigns according to locations and insects, for better performance analysis. sections.heading: Initial state
lines: Four accounts - two of them target registrations and sales. Two others are for mobile app and remarketing.

All the accounts campaigns were built via the K50 automatic tool. It was before pMax arised, but even so the crucial campaigns weren’t developed accordingly. There were campaign splits according to devices, demographics and languages as well as different campaigns as remarketing audiences targeting and observation.
In one month we checked every single of them with regards to spent, revenue, ROAS and other KPIs and rebuilt them from scratch (up to 3000 ad groups per single search campaign).

sections.heading: Work done
lines: • Paused underperforming and high spending campaigns, taking in account both direct and assisted transactions (and registrations)
Improved ad copies and created alternatives to split test
Improved ad assets and created new ad asset types
Adjusted bidding strategies and bids
Redistributed budgets
Paused certain ad groups and keywords and added other ones
Some of the campaigns were splitted according to seasonality
Campaigns were also splitted according to demographics, product categories and language
Dedicated shopping campaigns for housewares was created (weren’t advertised before)

Overall delivered optimization took up to three weeks of our dedicated team to review and adjust literally every keyword and dynamic URL after thorough performance review. Worth to mention that prior to our management there were plant of remarketing audiences in the account as well and targets, that weren’t properly tracked
• transactions were set as secondary(!), but not primary conversions
• most of remarketing audiences weren’t added to campaigns, but interest audiences were added as observations
We have agreed target KPIs, we had to reach in just one month.
Important requirement also was the fact that campaigns from different accounts shouldn’t have gotten into the same audition according to Google Policies.
